audit.why: Even/5.5 is defensible but the 55.41% WR over 1554 games and full-Syndra packet chart lean favoured; left the diff token as-is since the chart edits below already claim the lanes stages and diff/tone changes ripple to the mirror.

audit.why: Taliyah W (Seismic Shove) is 14s at rank 1 — her only burst setup, and Syndra holds E for it. Her R (Weaver's Wall) is 180/150/120s terrain that cuts a dashless Syndra's retreat. Her Q needs worked-ground stacks; Syndra's Q is instant at 800 range.
